heading: Dynamic-string production
text:
### Dynamic-string production [LNLS.3.2]

An interpolated string whose result is not a compile-time-provable
member of the DSC's interned string vocabulary is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_NOVEL_STRING`).

The compiler may approve an interpolated string only when every value
it renders is a string literal, a schema name, or a slot-name literal —
values whose interned identity is guaranteed to be in the table after
DSC load. One that renders a slot binding, or formats a number, is
excluded because the result may be a novel string not in the intern
table.

Rationale: a string a rule produces at run time would be a novel intern
entry on every firing, and so a table resize in the pump path. Strings that
arrive on asserted facts are a separate population ([LNLS.5.5]).
